verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sales-tax calculation, registration tracking for filings, and connectors that sync transactions into Kintsugi. Nothing documents Kintsugi generating compliant invoices, or pushing VAT fields, registration numbers, or locale invoice rules out to an invoicing system. Registrations and tax estimates are adjacent features, not invoice compliance.

support.subject: As an ops user, invoices come out compliant where I sell — required VAT fields, registration numbers, and locale rules flow through to my invoicing system or are generated by the product itself
